luiskr.com / core/utils/gpu/ring-sheen / mountRingSheen

function mountRingSheen(container, tilesSelector, canvasClass): RingSheenSession | null

Defined in: core/utils/gpu/ring-sheen.ts:83

mountRingSheen — overlays one instanced ring canvas on a tile container. Returns null when the surface can't mount (no GPU, no IntersectionObserver, reduced motion) — the CSS rings stay.

Parameters

container

HTMLElement

The positioned ancestor the canvas fills (.home-mosaic / .related-mosaic).

tilesSelector

string

Class selector for the ringed tiles.

canvasClass

string

Overlay canvas class (the :has() gate keys on it).

Returns

RingSheenSession | null

A session handle, or null when nothing was mounted.
